en: The postcard features a classic Renaissance portrait of a woman in profile, adorned with a pearl and gold net headdress, elegant jewelry, and a richly decorated blue and red garment. The lower section of the postcard contains printed text identifying the subject and origin of the artwork. The portrait is attributed to Leonardo da Vinci and is titled 'BEATRICE D'ESTE.' The location 'Pinacoteca Ambrosiana - Milano' is also noted, suggesting the artwork's current or historical location.
